compiled_state.title: [merge-to-main-pr]: gh pr merge --auto enqueued before _phase_resolve_threads -> downstream dispatch failures cannot un-queue auto-merge
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 89f9e8ef7c3708da755b586e04594c4ed98d2fe7
* **context:** merge-to-main-pr.sh PR-mode auto-merge ordering

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (review finding follow-up)

#### Expected Behavior

`gh pr merge --auto --merge` should be enqueued AFTER `_phase_resolve_threads`, `_dispatch_resolve_conflicts`, and `_dispatch_fix_agent` complete successfully. If any of those phases ESCALATE (rc=1/rc=2 from the fail-loud guards in 9e04-0eb6), auto-merge should not be queued — or, if already queued, the script should issue `gh pr merge --disable-auto` on its escalation exit path.

#### Actual Behavior

In `_phase_merge` (around line 429 of plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh), `gh pr merge "$_pr_number" --auto --merge` is enqueued immediately after PR creation, BEFORE `_phase_resolve_threads` runs (around line 1765). The bug 9e04-0eb6 fix made the LLM dispatch sites fail loud, but auto-merge has already been queued GitHub-side by the time the fail-loud kicks in. GitHub's required-checks gate is the only safeguard left at that point — there is no defense-in-depth from the script side.

The risk: a misconfiguration that fails the LLM dispatch can still result in auto-merge eventually firing if required-checks pass independently. Defense in depth requires either (a) moving the auto-merge enqueue to after all dispatch phases succeed, OR (b) issuing `gh pr merge --disable-auto "$_pr_number"` from the escalation cleanup path so a queued auto-merge cannot proceed when the script aborts.

### 3. Action History

1. Bug 9e04-0eb6 investigation surfaced this concern as a secondary finding (out of scope for that fix).
2. Investigator's final RESULT (test verdict 4: confirmed) — auto-merge ordering is unconditional on PR-creation success, not gated on `_phase_resolve_threads`.
3. The bug 9e04-0eb6 fix-bug session deferred this to a separate ticket per the no-feature-creep rule.

### 6. Logs

```
$ grep -n "gh pr merge\|_phase_resolve_threads\|_phase_merge" plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
~336: _phase_merge() { ... gh pr merge "$_pr_number" --auto --merge ... } # at ~line 429
~1765: _phase_resolve_threads "$_pr_number" "$_pr_url"
```

comments.body: Fixed: Moved gh pr merge --auto --merge out of _phase_merge and into a new _phase_queue_auto_merge helper. The new helper is called in the top-level flow AFTER _phase_resolve_threads succeeds (plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh, top-level section). If thread resolution fails or escalates, auto-merge is never queued. The auto_merge_disabled fallthrough path is preserved in _phase_queue_auto_merge. Also added regression test t_pr_auto_merge_queued_after_thread_resolution that inspects the gh argv log to confirm the pr view (resolve-threads) call appears before the pr merge --auto call.
